description: Monsoon forest, groves and paddies of the Indian subcontinent. Feast in the wet, sweat in the hot, harvest in the cool — the year breathes in three seasons and the land gives generously to those who learn its poisons.
hazards: monsoon floods (wet season — creeks rise fast)
name: South Asian Monsoon Lands

cool.note: Dry and cool. Harvest and festivals. The kind season.

hot.note: Heat builds. Wells drop. Work at dawn or not at all.

wet.note: The monsoon. Floods, rice, fever. Abundance with teeth.
